$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080, drawn with the share images' parts (src/assets/og.ts, from the brand social tool): the dashed rules, the headline in light Chakra Petch, notes in Kode Mono capitals, the globe and cube, the cog node as the bullet, the lockup in the band under the foot rule. Each type names the image template it is laid out from. Copy is the social tool's sample copy; a quote is attributed to a role at Acme, never a person.

cover.name: Cover
cover.description: The title top left inside the rules, a note under it at each side, the globe rising to the foot rule, the lockup bottom right.

slots.title: A workstation for your army of coding agents.
slots.body: Agents run in the cloud and let you know when they need input.
slots.note2: Every agent gets its own branch and its own sandbox.

section.name: Section
section.description: A section number in the mono over the title, a cube running off the right edge and the foot.

slots.title: Everything a swarm of agents needs.

statement.name: Statement
statement.description: One sentence centered over the globe's dome with its ring and pole node, the foot line under it.

slots.title: From request to reviewed pull request.

bullets.name: Bullets
bullets.description: The title top left and up to six points, each marked with a cog node, inside the rules; the lockup bottom right.

slots.title: What every thread does
slots.items: Runs in its own sandbox on its own branch | Runs the tests and drives a browser when the app has a preview | Opens a pull request for review | Asks before a sensitive action

stat.name: Stat
stat.description: A big figure and a line under it at the right, the globe at the left, one dashed rule along the foot.

slots.title: of the way out of beta.
slots.body: Thousands of threads run on Hoplite every day.

quote.name: Quote
quote.description: A quote in light Chakra Petch inside the rules and who said it in mono capitals (a role at Acme); the lockup bottom right.

slots.quote: Every agent gets its own branch and its own sandbox, so we review pull requests instead of babysitting terminals.

image.name: Image
image.description: The title and a note, and a picture (image) in the drawing's place inside corner ticks; without a picture, the globe.

slots.title: Watch every agent at work.
slots.body: Each thread runs the tests, drives a browser when the app has a preview, and opens a pull request.

end.name: End card
end.description: The lockup large over the dome, the address and the tagline along the foot.
